sectors.name: Cybersecurity & Critical Infrastructure

sectors.name: Data Protection & Privacy (PDPL / GDPR)

sectors.name: Cloud Sovereignty & Hyperscale Compliance

sectors.name: Fintech, Open Banking & Crypto Assets
sectors.description: Central bank cybersecurity mandates, API security for open banking, stablecoin reserves, and anti-money laundering digital controls.

sectors.name: Operational Resilience & Disaster Recovery
sectors.description: Mandatory recovery point/time objectives (RPO/RTO), third-party concentration risk, and systemic crisis simulation drills.

sectors.name: Telecommunications & Digital Platforms
sectors.description: Spectrum cybersecurity, submarine cable integrity, VoIP licensing, lawful interception, and OTT platform governance.
sectors.regulatoryFocus: Strict carrier-grade lawful intercept compliance and local POP hosting requirements.

sectors.name: OT / Industrial Control Systems (Energy & Utilities)
sectors.description: SCADA, DCS, and pipeline cyber safety mandates safeguarding oil & gas, desalination, power generation, and port logistics.
sectors.regulatoryFocus: Air-gapped architecture verification, physical-digital perimeter zoning, and supply chain inspection.
